learning_objectives: By the end of this tutorial, you will be able to apply the 3Cs - Clarity, Conciseness, and Context - to write effective prompts for AI tools.
outline: Welcome to the 3Cs of Prompting Tutorial
prerequisites: This tutorial assumes you have a basic understanding of using a web browser and accessing online tools. No prior knowledge of AI prompting is required.

slides.title: Welcome to the 3Cs of Prompting Tutorial
slides.narration:
Hello.
Welcome to this Spoken Tutorial on the 3 Cs of Prompting.
Here, we will learn to write good prompts for **AI** tools.
This will help you get correct and useful answers.
slides.image_prompt: Welcome screen for a tutorial on 'The 3Cs of Prompting', featuring a friendly AI assistant character and three distinct icons representing Clarity, Conciseness, and Context.

slides.title: Learning Objective
slides.narration:
After this tutorial, you will know how to use the 3 Cs.
These are Clarity, Conciseness, and Context.
You can use them to write good prompts for **AI** tools like **ChatGPT**.
slides.image_prompt: A modern graphic displaying 'Learning Objective' with bullet points: 'Apply 3Cs', 'Write Effective Prompts', 'Understand AI Tools'. Stylized icons for each point.

slides.title: System Requirements
slides.narration:
To follow this tutorial, you need a computer.
It should have an internet connection.
Please use a web browser like **Chrome** or **Firefox**.
We will use **ChatGPT** for examples, so open chatgpt.com.
slides.image_prompt: Illustration of a desktop computer with a web browser open to chatgpt.com. Icons for Chrome and Firefox are visible, representing system requirements.

slides.title: Prerequisites
slides.narration:
You should know how to use a web browser.
You should also know how to open online tools.
You do not need to know anything about **AI** prompting before this tutorial.
slides.image_prompt: A simple graphic showing a user effortlessly navigating a web browser, implying basic computer literacy. A thought bubble says 'No AI prompting knowledge needed!'

slides.title: What are the 3Cs of Prompting?
slides.narration:
The 3 Cs of Prompting are Clarity, Conciseness, and Context.
These three ideas help us write **prompts**.
Good **prompts** give the best answers from **AI**.
Let us learn about each one.
slides.image_prompt: A visual representation of the '3Cs of Prompting' (Clarity, Conciseness, Context) as three interconnected pillars or gears, leading to an output from an AI model.

slides.title: C1: Clarity
slides.narration:
Clarity means your **prompt** should be easy to understand.
Do not use unclear words or difficult terms.
Tell the **AI** exactly what you want it to do.
Also, tell what kind of answer you expect.
slides.image_prompt: An illustration of a clear, sparkling magnifying glass focusing on a piece of text that says 'Clear Prompt'. Background is blurred jargon.

slides.title: Clarity Example: Bad Prompt
slides.narration:
Let us see an example for Clarity.
Here is a bad **prompt**: 'Tell me about India.'
This is too general.
The **AI** will give a very broad or not useful answer.
slides.image_prompt: A thought bubble from an AI showing a very vague, scattered, and overwhelming array of images related to 'India' (e.g., map, food, culture, history, economy all jumbled together), illustrating a broad and unhelpful response.

slides.title: Clarity Example: Good Prompt
slides.narration:
Now, see a good **prompt**: 'Summarize the main economic challenges facing India in 2023.'
This is very clear.
It asks for specific information.
You will get a focused answer.
slides.image_prompt: A thought bubble from an AI showing a focused and organized summary about 'Economic Challenges in India 2023', with clear headings and concise points. The AI looks pleased.

slides.title: C2: Conciseness
slides.narration:
Conciseness means using few words to give your message.
Remove words that are not needed.
Go straight to the main point.
This helps the **AI** understand without confusion.
slides.image_prompt: An image of a pair of scissors trimming a long, winding piece of text into a short, straight, and impactful phrase, symbolizing conciseness.

slides.title: Conciseness Example: Bad Prompt
slides.narration:
Here is a **prompt** that is not concise.
It is: 'Generate a long story about a knight, a quest, a princess, and a dragon.'
This **prompt** has many extra words.
The **AI** may get confused.
slides.image_prompt: A visually cluttered AI screen showing a very long, convoluted prompt. The AI character looks confused, scratching its head amidst too many words.

slides.title: Conciseness Example: Good Prompt
slides.narration:
A concise **prompt** is: 'Write about a knight saving a princess from a dragon.'
It gives the same message.
It uses fewer words.
The **AI** can process it easily.
slides.image_prompt: A clean AI interface showing a short, impactful prompt. The AI character looks focused and ready to respond efficiently.

slides.title: C3: Context
slides.narration:
Context means giving background information to the **AI**.
This helps the **AI** understand the situation well.
It gives a more correct answer.
Tell the **AI** its role, how the answer should look, or who it is for.
slides.image_prompt: An illustration of an AI model being given a pair of glasses or a headset labeled 'Context', allowing it to see and understand a scene more clearly, moving from a blurry image to a sharp one.

slides.title: Context Example: Bad Prompt
slides.narration:
See this **prompt** without context: 'Give five tips for learning a language.'
The **AI** does not know who needs the tips.
It also does not know what kind of tips are needed.
The answer may be too general.
slides.image_prompt: An AI character shrugging, holding a generic list of '5 Tips for Learning a Language' that could apply to anyone. It looks unsure about the target audience or specific needs.

slides.title: Context Example: Good Prompt
slides.narration:
With context, the **prompt** is: 'As tutor, give five tips for Spanish beginners.'
Now, the **AI** knows its role.
It also knows who the tips are for.
This gives better advice.
slides.image_prompt: An AI character wearing a 'language tutor' badge, confidently presenting a tailored list of '5 Practical Tips for Beginner Spanish Learners'. It looks knowledgeable and helpful.

slides.title: Summary of 3Cs
slides.narration:
In this tutorial, we learned about the **3 Cs of Prompting**.
They are Clarity, Conciseness, and Context.
We saw how these ideas help us write good **prompts** for **AI** tools.
Remember to make your **prompts** clear, short, and give enough background.
slides.image_prompt: A summary infographic showing Clarity, Conciseness, and Context in a clean, professional design, with small icons and keywords for each 'C', leading to a larger icon representing 'Effective AI Prompts'.

slides.title: Assignment
slides.narration:
Here is your assignment.
Go to chatgpt.com.
Try to write three different **prompts** for a short story.
For each **prompt**, use Clarity, Conciseness, and Context.
See how the **AI**'s answer changes when your **prompts** are better.
slides.image_prompt: A notepad with 'Assignment' written at the top, showing three blank lines for 'Prompt 1', 'Prompt 2', 'Prompt 3'. A pencil and an AI assistant encouraging the user.
